question: Israel Election: Any Coalition Wins a Majority?
resolution_criteria: Yes if either (a) The Democrats, Yashar, Together and Yisrael Beiteinu or (b) Likud, Otzma Yehudit, RZP-Zehut, Amcha Yisrael, UTJ and Shas win 61 or more seats combined in the October 27, 2026 election. Resolves with Polymarket market israel-election-any-coalition-wins-a-majority.

history.rationale: Sprint forecast for fast resolutions. No independent news view: this is the market price 20.0% with the standing favorite-longshot rule (prices under 10% or over 90% moved 30% closer to the edge, in between left as is). It tests whether that rule beats the market.
10/27/2026 update, same method as the sprint: market price 8.0% with the favorite-longshot rule (under 10% or over 90% moved 30% closer to the edge, floor 1%). No independent news view.

resolution.post_mortem: Resolved no. Our last number was 5.6%; the market's last saved price before archival was 0.85%. Brier 0.003. 53-48-19 split; no bloc reached 61. Official CEC results certified 2026-11-04 (israelvote.meforum.org, israelnationalnews.com/news/435272): Likud 27, Yashar 21, Together 12, Joint List 11, Democrats 8, Raam 8, Yisrael Beytenu 7 (5.93%), Otzma 7, UTJ 7, Shas 6, RZ-Zehut 6; Netanyahu bloc 53, opposition 48, Arab parties 19; Amcha Yisrael 1.68%, below the threshold.
